records.outcome_direction: The triple combination increased RT-4 death and inhibited colonies; late apoptosis/necrosis exceeded gemcitabine/cisplatin doublet treatment. Bax/Bcl-2 rose in RT-4 combinations but decreased in proTAME-treated ARPE-19; Cdc20 expression declined in combined groups.
